caption: The drawing shows a young person with short, curly brown hair, pale skin, and red lips, standing and facing forward with one arm slightly extended to the side. This person is wearing a long red dress decorated with a small repeating yellow and black pattern, featuring wide sleeves and a fitted waist. Around the neck, there is a white ruffled collar, and the lower part of the dress reveals white knee-length undergarments with lace trim and light blue horizontal stripes below the knee. The person wears brown lace-up boots and striped pale blue and white socks. In their left hand, they hold a basket made of straw, which has a fan-shaped structure with a wide red ruffled fabric trim. The background is a plain off-white color, and the signature “Eugene Croe” is visible in the bottom right corner.
title: Doll: "Camela"
